behaviorMappings.name: falls back to a coherent state when a complete writer crosses the read window
behaviorMappings.retired: Overlapping writer completes between YAML and Run read; inode/mtime window retry or serialized fallback.
behaviorMappings.preserved: One controller reads initial before, awaits complete serial write, then both normal and readonly reads see coherent after phase/Run/currentStep/iteration; committed YAML bytes are not rewritten.

target.fullName: Classic state projection reads coherent YAML and Run state after a complete serial writer commits

behaviorMappings.expected: One controller reads initial before, awaits complete serial write, then both normal and readonly reads see coherent after phase/Run/currentStep/iteration; committed YAML bytes are not rewritten.
behaviorMappings.forbidden: Restore a serialized reader, inode/hash/mtime cache or writer lock; silently lose committed/manual state changes; return a partly written transaction as successful; overwrite original data while diagnosing incomplete WAL.

behaviorMappings.name: observes a same-size manual edit even when the original mtime is restored
behaviorMappings.retired: Injecting a manual edit after YAML was already read by mocking readRunState; concurrent read-window retry.
behaviorMappings.preserved: Manual edit occurs between two actual reads in one async controller sequence. Actual UTF8 byte length stays equal and old mtime is restored (<1ms difference); next read sees new phase, retains Run and exact edited bytes.

behaviorMappings.retired: Active writer and independent reader synchronize through a newly opened SQLite lock; await on that deleted lock acquisition.
